notes: Manual context entries for coins with known structural narratives.

coins.name: Bitcoin Cash
coins.summary: Forked from BTC in 2017 to pursue larger-block payments. Narrative weakened after multiple community splits and limited merchant traction.
structural_headwinds: Repeated forks and governance splits weakened long-term cohesion.
Payments narrative is crowded and BCH has lagged on mindshare.
Past highs relied on early-cycle fork hype rather than durable adoption.
